author: MLGHarambe420
body: I was banned six months ago by resepignev, a staff member. He rightfully accused me of fly hacks. (although it was a simple mod not a hack) I had joined the server five months before my ban and enjoyed playing Destroy the Monument. When I installed the mod, I did not install it for the purpose of flying around in DtM. However, my key binding for fly was set to CTRL,while sprint was set to MOUSE4. Normally, a Minecraft player would use CTRL as sprint, and I was unaware that I had clicked down on CTRL, attempting to sprint when instead I turned on flying. I assumed that I was lagging or my internet had timed out. I know this seems far-fetched but I think i have done my time with this ban. Thank you.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
"Han",

I agree with you pal! You have waited long enough, at least in my opinion. I'm going to ask that you don't use the sprint mods, and especially not hack. We have rules for those on the rules page. If you do, you're gonna be banned again with no appeal.

Also, I hate your name! You're an awful person.

Welcome back.
